content.subject: Apparel fulfillment and reconciliation load
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

Your new apparel‑specific fulfillment center targets returns and SKU complexity. The move should shift a sizable portion of returns processing away from manual handling.

When SKU variety spikes, manual reconciliation consumes disproportionate accounting hours. That pressure surfaces as hidden labor in month‑end close. Finance teams allocate extra staff to keep the books balanced.

We run bots that cross‑check return transactions against SKU ledgers and post adjustments.

Is the extra reconciliation load still manageable for your finance team?

Zamp
